responsibility: Implements the GIMPLE pass that isolates CFG paths leading to statically-detectable undefined or erroneous behavior. It detects explicit or PHI-fed null/zero misuse and related impossible paths, duplicates and redirects basic blocks when only certain incoming edges trigger the problem, replaces offending operations with __builtin_trap or zero-return rewrites when appropriate, adjusts edge probabilities/counts, and requests CFG/SSA cleanup so later optimizers can treat the isolated path as terminating.
